programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Food For the Heart
programme.desc: Chef Lia plans to expand her non-profit heart-centered meal delivery service flounder due to her insistence on doing everything herself. But with the help of her new neighbor and recent adoptee father Eli she’ll discover that business, just like romance, can flourish with a little effort and trust.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.desc: Lizzie gets excited when she lands a new real estate client, but it ends up being Collin, who isn't as subtle with his interest as he thinks. Elinor unexpectedly gets a promotion, but before she can celebrate, she learns that the promotion makes her the one to deal with the IRS when her employer’s company comes under investigation. The IRS agent she deals with is Edward Ferrars, and a pleasant surprise from the typical IRS agent she expected. Emma and her coworker Mr. Darcy have to work on a case together. Emma finds her legal methods are different from Darcy’s, and frustration ensues until both can stop to understand the other’s perspective.

programme.title: Austentatious
programme.sub-title: Hit Me With Your Best Shot
programme.desc: Lizzie deals with coordinating her family’s wardrobe for a family portrait, with constant resistance to her ideas and suggestions of wild animal prints from her mother. Marianne gets a job at Yum Divine (a dessert bistro of sorts), but repeatedly messes up to the point of having her new job on the chopping block. Through Elinor’s insistence, and everyone’s help, Marianne hangs on to her job—barely. Grant figures out that Emma’s love of match-making comes as a therapy for all the divorce cases she handles. He recounts all the terrible dates Emma has sent him on. Lizzie learns that Grant might just love Emma.

programme.title: Scents and Sensibility
programme.desc: In this modern adaptation of Jane Austen’s Sense and Sensibility, Elinor and Marianne find themselves penniless after their father’s fortune is taken away. As they look for ways to pay the bills, they encounter people who judge them and try to keep them down in the dumps. Add falling in love into the mix, and determining whom to trust becomes a mine field. Can the sisters find a balance between relying on their hearts and using good sense without losing everything they hold dear?

programme.title: Love, Alaska
programme.desc: When two childhood friends are reunited through a generous inheritance that bestows far more on their broken hearts than they bargained for - a second chance at love.

programme.title: Romance on the Ranch
programme.desc: When her truck breaks down in the mid-west, Sara is invited to park her camper on a family ranch while her truck is repaired. She meets two brothers, who are as different as night and day. The brothers are instantly smitten with Sara and soon she begins to have feelings for them both. The last thing Sara expected to find was romance on the ranch.

programme.title: Love Unleashed
programme.desc: After her dog runs away Sarah learns he's been adopted. As she and the new owner, Mike, battle over custody the pair fall in love. But Mike has a secret and Sarah walks away. Can true love prevail?

programme.desc: The beauty editor of a women's magazine persuades an up-and-coming photographer to pretend to be her boyfriend when her ex gets engaged to somebody else. They will have to work together to shake up the magazine's waning reputation.
